purpose: Owner-approved implementation and evaluation of an initial approximate quarter-BPM tap that selects only a metrical octave layer.

latest_owner_scope.tap_applies_to: initial section only; current whole-input use relies on constant BPM and constant meter

dataflow: Read source-only identity/geometry and the current clean-room experiment's fresh official Beat This logits.
Before opening hint inputs, generate the audio-only base rhythm family, all admissible octave layers, rational BPM neighbors, meter/phase proposals and their scores.
Convert the initial tap once to an integer power-of-two layer index relative to the audio-derived base. An exact geometric boundary is ambiguous; an unsupported layer does not produce a guessed map.
Discard the continuous tap number. Select only from the already prepared layer's candidates.
Emit the audio-derived precise BPM, inferred 3/4 or 4/4, and inferred global audio-relative downbeat offset.
Save every prediction before opening evaluation reference event files.

source_only_family_search.base_search: Unchanged first-experiment source-only optimizer and objective
source_only_family_search.layers: Powers of two around the audio base, with admissible candidates in the fixed rational pool
source_only_family_search.neighbor_radius: max(0.25,120/input_duration_seconds) scaled by octave and capped at 10% of the audio-derived center; independent of any hint
source_only_family_search.phase_search: Original whole-input folding seeds, all bar positions, source-only ranking and top-10 refinement at 2 ms steps
source_only_family_search.meter: Inferred from beat/downbeat evidence; no per-sample meter value enters inference

interface.unsupported_fields_rejected: All other fields, including time signature, reference times and offsets
interface.raw_hint_receipts: Stored outside predictions for provenance, never consumed by numerical refinement or scoring

experiment.hint_origin: Reference-derived correct-unit diagnostic, explicitly authorized by owner; no actual human taps were collected
conditions: Matched audio-family control without a hint
Reference BPM used only as a unit hint
experiment.invariance: Compare the entire model prediction, including exact BPM, meter, offset, scores and flags; same layer must mean exact equality
experiment.evaluation: Reuse the unchanged first-experiment accepted-event adapters and timing metrics on the same 26 samples
experiment.timing_reference_limit: Owner-approved practical maps are not independent original-click millisecond certificates

examples: 79.75 sensor evidence with a 160 hint produces 159.5, not 160
No evidence cannot produce a clock from a tap
Unavailable layer and invalid inputs are handled
